role_voices.text_en: Married with kids? I don't want that!

role_voices.text_zh: 見識過絕世美景，誰還想被囚禁在皇城。
role_voices.text_en: Who would be caged in a palace after witnessing such beauty?

role_voices.text_zh: 母親說我和她很像……難不成她也想出門玩？
role_voices.text_en: Mother said I'm a lot like her... Does that mean she wants to go out and play too?

role_voices.text_zh: 那些富家子弟、王公貴族都沒你有趣！
role_voices.text_en: Those rich kids, nobles and aristocrats are not as interesting as you!

role_voices.text_zh: 要跟我喝酒？好啊，我奉陪到底！
role_voices.text_en: Do you want to drink with me? Alright, I'm down!

role_voices.text_zh: 哈哈哈——別鬧了，這樣很癢！
role_voices.text_en: Hahaha -- Stop messing around, that tickles!

role_voices.text_zh: 想清楚，做了就不能回頭囉♥
role_voices.text_en: Think this through, there's no turning back now♥

role_voices.text_zh: 哼哼～我會「玩」的東西可多了！
role_voices.text_en: Hmph~ I'm good at all kinds of "fun"!

role_voices.text_zh: 嗯……我好像喝多了，要不你陪陪我？
role_voices.text_en: Hmm... I seemed to have drunk too much, can you keep me company?

role_voices.text_zh: 連母親都沒這麼打過我！
role_voices.text_en: Not even my mother has ever hit me!

role_voices.text_zh: 真是場酣暢淋漓的比試！
role_voices.text_en: That was a truly exhilarating match!
